digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflows — predates-gate guard consolidation
propositions: The predates-gate guard pattern (24 copies across .github/) is unevenly applied, causing defects when guards drift or are omitted: anxious-resistant-urson (missing guard) and sapphire-vulnerable-fruitfly (late addition).

A shared implementation of the guard (composite action, shell helper, or Python module) is mechanically infeasible because it lives in the repo and is absent on pre-gate trees where the guard must run.

Every gate step that invokes repo-local scripts or data files must carry either an `-f` guard for the exact path with the canonical skip message, or a mandatory-reason `# predates-gate-ok:` marker; violations are caught by test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py.
Every guarded step body must exit 0 and print 'change predates the gate' when run in an empty directory, generalizing the single-site mutation-selector pin to all 24 guards.

Four sites carry behavior that a bare skip would silently drop and must keep their current bodies: _mutation.yml (also writes matrix output), _optionality.yml (independent generators), _build-and-test.yml (inverted form with no exit 0, data file sort chain).
Genuine guard gaps discovered during this work are filed and linked `discovered_from` rather than fixed here, because adding a guard changes which gates run on old bases and requires separate review.
